uncertainty: The paper reports 70.28% from a 90-mode modal calculation and treats it as the exact diffraction efficiency; no raw numerical trace is available.
notes: The period, depth, and duty-cycle text is cross-checked against Chiou et al. (2009); its duty cycle denotes the chrome fraction.
Chiou et al. report T0=0.69828465 at 365 orders, exposing a small literature-level discrepancy with the 0.7028 value quoted by Lalanne and Morris.
Only the zeroth exterior order propagates for this geometry, so total transmitted power equals T0.
This is a Fourier-factorization acceptance benchmark, not a frozen Khepri fixture.
